errata.orig:
This
         request MUST include the same SIA extension that is present in
         the CURRENT CA certificate.
errata.correct:
The AccessDescriptions with accessMethods of id-ad-caRepository in the
request's SIA extension MUST be the same as the AccessDescriptions with
accessMethods of id-ad-caRepository in the CURRENT CA certificate's SIA
extension.
errata.notes: An RFC6487-compliant CA certificate's SIA extension has AccessDescriptions for both its repository (id-ad-caRepository) and its manifest (id-ad-rpkiManifest). Section 2 of RFC6489 also states, "While the 'current' and 'new' CA instances share a single repository publication point, each CA has its own CRL and its own manifest." This indicates that only the id-ad-caRepository AccessDescriptions should be identical, not the id-ad-rpkiManifest AccessDescriptions.
